The 'Player' class label in tu_map comes only from that misnamed constructor symbol.

notes: Text-only fold of 88 one-function shards (0x020c8dd4 dMgTrmpln2Mario_c::GetVelocity .. 0x020cd72c dMgTrmpObjAdapter_c C2). Both Marios' slot overrides (GetPos, GetPrevPos, GetVelocity, IsActive) are real methods, so GetPos is each class's key function and this TU emits both Mario vtables and typeinfos; they are discarded against the cartridge's copies (compiler_only_output deadstrip-data).

Folded __sinit_ov006_0212f6b4 into this TU. mwcc emits __sinit_d_mg_trmpln2_mario.cpp. @2155-@2166 clash with ov002 and are renamed to unused same-length names. The goal slots are TrmpGoal, not Vector3(x, y, z): ten of them store through an unsigned int*, and the cartridge does not. ~TrmpGoal is aliased to ~Vector3 after the unreferenced vague ~Vector3 import is parked on func_02017a9c.

compiler_only_output.reason: This TU odr-uses Vector3 by value, so mwccarm re-emits Vector3's trivial vague-linkage D1 alongside the licensed text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0 and an enrolled source already owns it; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

Base-object constructor emitted beside C1 by the out-of-line dMgTrmpln2Mario_c::dMgTrmpln2Mario_c(). The cartridge carries only C1 at 0x020ca78c (size 0x2c), and dMgTrmpln2Mario_c is only ever constructed as a complete object (dScMgTrampoline2_c's five-Mario array, through __cxa_vec_ctor), so C2 has no ROM home. Homeless and unreferenced, so a plain deadstrip.

Base-object destructor emitted beside D1 by the out-of-line dMgTrmpln2Mario_c::~dMgTrmpln2Mario_c(). The cartridge carries only D1 at 0x020ca604 (size 0x188), which dScMgTrampoline2_c hands to the array helpers; no module's symbols.txt gives D2 a home. Homeless and unreferenced, so a plain deadstrip.

Homeless deleting destructor: mwcc emits D0 for a polymorphic class even though this destructor is not virtual -- the vtable at 0x0213b2e0 is five slots (GetPos, GetPrevPos, GetVelocity, IsActive, Clear) and none is a destructor. No symbols.txt names a D0 for this class and nothing in the image calls one, so a plain deadstrip (the same disposition ov006/dMgJump3DMario_c records).

Base-object constructor emitted beside C1 by the out-of-line dMgTrmpln3DMario_c::dMgTrmpln3DMario_c(). The cartridge carries only C1 at 0x020cd12c (size 0x2c), and dMgTrmpln3DMario_c is only ever constructed as a complete object (dScMgTrampoline_c's four-Mario array, through __cxa_vec_ctor), so C2 has no ROM home. Homeless and unreferenced, so a plain deadstrip.

The cartridge carries only D1 at 0x020ccfc8 (size 0x164), which dScMgTrampoline_c hands to the array helpers; no module's symbols.txt gives D2 a home. No symbols.txt names a D0 for this class and nothing in the image calls one, so a plain deadstrip (the same disposition ov006/dMgJump3DMario_c records).

Complete-object constructor emitted beside the licensed base-object C2 at 0x020cd6f4 by the out-of-line dMgTrmpRingObjAdapter_c::dMgTrmpRingObjAdapter_c(). The ring adapter is only ever constructed as dMgTrmpln2Mario_c's base (its C1 calls C2), so no ov006 symbols.txt row configures a C1 home and no surviving relocation reaches one -- the same disposition ov006/dMg3DHeyhoObjAdapter_c takes for its adapter's C1.
